Similarly, unforeseen technological, geopolitical, or natural disaster events could introduce volatility that isn’t captured by the typical patterns used to make this forecast. These risks highlight the inherent limitations of probabilistic forecasts, particularly over longer time periods. While the intervals are designed to reflect 90% of possible outcomes, outliers can and do occur.
